_comment: Cases where Concha differs from Strudel's snapshots because the snapshots come from Strudel's test runtime (test/runtime.mjs), not from strudel.cc. Concha follows strudel.cc. Reviewed 2026-11-16.
example tune #0: test runtime replaces .tune() by a no-op; Concha runs @strudel/xen's tune
example tune #1: same: .tune() is a no-op in the test runtime
example tune #2: same: .tune() is a no-op in the test runtime
example getFrequency #0: same: .tune() is a no-op in the test runtime
example filter #0: test runtime replaces .filter() by a no-op
example duckorbit #0: several $: patterns: the test runtime keeps the last one, strudel.cc's repl stacks them all
example duckorbit #1: same: $: patterns are stacked by the repl
example filterValues #0: same: labelled patterns are stacked by the repl
example useRNG #0: same: $: patterns are stacked by the repl
example seed #0: same: $: patterns are stacked by the repl
example filterWhen #0: labelled pattern: the test runtime ignores the label, the repl runs it through .p() (filterWhen then keeps cycle 0 only)
example keyDown #0: the test runtime has no window, so keyDown throws and gives no haps; on strudel.cc with no key pressed, pick() plays its first pattern
example whenKey #0: same: no window in the test runtime; with no key pressed the pattern plays unchanged
example adsr #0: test runtime replaces .adsr() by a no-op
example markcss #0: test runtime replaces .markcss() by a no-op; strudel.cc's codemirror registers it as a control
example duckattack #0: labelled / $: patterns: the test runtime keeps the last one, the repl stacks them all
example duckattack #1: labelled / $: patterns: the test runtime keeps the last one, the repl stacks them all
example duckdepth #1: labelled / $: patterns: the test runtime keeps the last one, the repl stacks them all
example duckonset #0: labelled / $: patterns: the test runtime keeps the last one, the repl stacks them all
example duckonset #1: labelled / $: patterns: the test runtime keeps the last one, the repl stacks them all
example duckonset #2: labelled / $: patterns: the test runtime keeps the last one, the repl stacks them all
